message: Android 0.1.56 (57) is available through the official direct-download lane. The per-file attachment limit is now 512 MB, with a 1 GB batch limit and a 256 MB free-space reserve. The misleading 从微信添加 launcher has been removed: the card file + button opens Android's system document picker, while files from WeChat, QQ, email, cloud drives, browsers, and other compatible apps can be opened or shared directly to 源图casepro. Private-storage copy, streaming SHA-256 validation, duplicate removal, authentication, and rollback protections remain enforced. The exact signed APK passed 767 automated tests, full lint, R8, 16 KiB alignment, and retained-data OPPO verification including a real 67.11 MB PDF import. Tencent AppBao currently continues to serve 0.1.53 (54); a store update is a separate submission and review.
